name: Three-Week Study Residency, Clearwater Dharma House
summary: Three weeks in residence for 6, on a fixed daily timetable of sitting, text study, and discussion. No teacher; a peer-led seminar format. Some prior practice needed. CAD 2,800.
description:
A residency for practitioners who want to study a text closely with others rather than be taught.

**Format**
Six residents, one text (this year: the Satipatthana Sutta and two commentaries), three weeks. The timetable is fixed: 6:00 sit, 7:00 breakfast, 8:30 to 11:30 seminar, lunch, 13:30 to 15:00 individual reading, 15:00 walk or work, 17:00 sit, supper, 19:30 evening discussion. Attendance at all sessions is expected.

**No teacher**
The seminar is peer-led. Each resident prepares and leads sessions in rotation. The house has a large library and a resident librarian who is not a teacher and will not act as one. This is deliberate: the residency is for people who have had teachers and want to work without one for a while.

**Conversation**
This is a talking residency. Seminars are discussion; meals are not silent; evenings are open conversation.

**Physical**
Moderate. Daily walks on the shore trail, an hour of house work, sitting periods of 45 minutes.

**Fit**
You should have several years of practice and some familiarity with the early Buddhist texts. Not a beginner's course.

**Cost**
CAD 2,800 including single room, meals, and library access.
practical: Three weeks, twice a year, spring and autumn. CAD 2,800. Six single rooms. Three vegetarian meals. Bring reading glasses, a notebook, walking shoes, rain gear. Ferry to Nanaimo, then bus; we collect from Port Alberni. Wifi in the library only.
